subtitle: Lesson 5 · Chapter 1: Migrating the First Workload to Azure

eyebrow: From an empty VM to a running app
code:
ssh azureuser@<vm-catalog01-public-ip>

sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y nodejs npm
scp -r ./catalog-app azureuser@<vm-ip>:/opt/catalog-app
sudo systemctl enable --now catalog-app
caption: Lift-and-shift: the same running shape as the on-prem server.

eyebrow: Opening exactly what the app needs
code:
az network nsg rule create \
  --resource-group rg-driftwood-eastus-catalog \
  --nsg-name vm-catalog01NSG \
  --name allow-http \
  --priority 200 \
  --destination-port-ranges 80 \
  --access Allow \
  --protocol Tcp
caption: One new rule -- not a wider range "to be safe."

eyebrow: Validating the app actually serves traffic
On purpose, still out of scope
